title: Hear What the Voice from Heaven Proclaims
description: Hear What the Voice from Heaven Proclaims in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 18, headed “Blessed are the dead that die in the Lord, Rev. 14. 13”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Hear what the voice from heaven pro-claims, For all the pi-ous dead, Sweet is the sa-vour of their names, And soft their sleep-ing bed.

lines: Hear what the voice from heaven proclaims,
Sweet is the savour of their names,
They die in Jesus, and are bless'd;
From sufferings and from sins releas'd,
Far from this world of toil and strife,
The labours of their mortal life

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
